summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which detects platform/arch, downloads a Bun runtime archive from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a tmp directory, chmods the extracted `bun` binary, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js], {cwd: D})`. The sibling `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball is a 727KB obfuscated `@bun-cjs` bundle using string-array rotation (`WV8StW` rotating a multi-thousand-entry `n7gIxM` table) and hex-mangled identifiers; setup.mjs itself also uses `_0x…` identifier obfuscation. The advertised purpose of the package is a Cypress selector helper — `dist/index.js` only re-exports `chat-ui-selectors` — so the alternate-runtime dropper and opaque Bun bundle are unrelated to any stated function. Deliberate use of a freshly-downloaded second runtime to execute an obfuscated bundle at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern; installing this version causes attacker-chosen bytes to run under Bun on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
